name: Doraemon
source:
Doraemon is sent back in time by Nobita Nobi's great-great grandson Sewashi to improve Nobita's circumstances so that his descendants may enjoy a better future


use FFD system version 2.0.6 of littlewitch
translation:
哆啦A梦被野比大雄的玄孙世修送回过去，帮助大雄改善境遇，好让他的后代拥有更美好的未来。

本作使用Littlewitch的FFD System 2.0.6。
